decisions.reason: The client postpones delivery of the escalation email until Monday but does not change the approved notice content or its drafting requirements.
Waiting for certified-mail receipt motivates the email delay, but the client does not change the certified-mail delivery requirement or any of its current attributes.
The source decision concerns the later escalation follow-up email, not the distinct initial borrower email accompanying the certified mailing.
Postponing the escalation email does not alter the formal demand letter's content, addressees, authorization, or issuance requirements.
